description:
Publish a container's site at `domain`: write the host nginx reverse-proxy (with the
    /websocket→gevent location) and, if a Cloudflare token is given (BY PATH: token_file=<path>,
    never inline), create a PROXIED A record for `domain` → the box IP and - for tls='flexible' -
    add a Cloudflare Configuration Rule that sets SSL=Flexible SCOPED TO THIS HOST ONLY (it NEVER
    changes the zone-wide SSL mode, so a zone on Full(Strict) stays Strict for everything else).
    `version` picks the host ports (http 80xx / gevent 81xx). For a production box prefer an origin
    cert + keep Strict instead of Flexible. dry_run shows the nginx + the planned CF calls.
name: docker_domain
